label: late original-phase steps (pos 6-8) in sequences starting with q
explanation: Sparse feature that fires only in the last 1-3 original-phase positions (orig_idx 6-8, so mostly L=8-9) and almost only when the first original token is q (80% of activation mass; next_out=q at the DEL step is the same effect). It is essentially silent in the copy phase, fires weakly on a few DEL steps, and never fires before position 5. The predicate covers ~79% of activation mass but has low precision (~10%): only a small fraction of late steps in q-initial sequences fire. Which ones fire depends on the current input token. in_tok n/q/u (also e) give much higher rates and the largest activations; restricting to those raises precision to ~0.37 but cuts mass recall to ~0.41. Rare activations in non-q sequences are weak (often first token l).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=q (+6.47), orig_idx=6 (+3.98), prev_tok=g (+3.56), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=n (+3.30), orig0=l (+3.16), prev_tok=j (+2.88). Lower it: phase=2 (-4.70), next_out=- (-3.11), prev3_tok=- (-2.38), t=4 (-2.29).
